paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
heading: Grepgui Tungthu Gentehna

paite: "Mihing tapa, sing dang sang in gammang nuai a sing lak a grepgui bang ahi tuam a le?
Thil bawlna dia asing zat ahi hia? Tui-um belsuan khaina ding in kua'n azang ngei a le?
Ngai in, mei a paihlut ahi a, toh ding in mei in akangmang, among langnih, akang khin a alai ah phattuamna anei a hia?
Ngai in, abit lai nangawn in aphatuam kei; akatmang khit nung in, phatuam sin kei na tel e!"
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Gamnuai sing lak a grep guite, toh ding in mei ah ka khul maimah bang in, Jerusalem luah mite ka bawl ding.
Amau ka masuan ding a, pawt mah le uh, mei a kipan, akangbei ding, mei in, TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh; amaute ka masuan hun chiang in.
Agam uh ka hihgawp ngei ding ahi, thulimlouhna ahih ziak un chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
